display.purpose: Hero headlines on marketing pages. Fraunces serif for institutional authority.

body.purpose: All running text, descriptions, and content. Lexend for screen readability.

label.purpose: Form labels, navigation items, button text, badges.

mono.purpose: Section eyebrows, metadata labels, the 'LET Review' identifier. Structural accent only.

shadows.name: marketing-frame
shadows.purpose: Decorative lift on the marketing product screenshot frame. Not replicated in app interior.

shadows.name: mobile-sidebar
shadows.purpose: Functional separation for the sliding mobile sidebar overlay.

shadows.name: button-primary
shadows.purpose: Subtle presence on primary buttons. Removed on hover for tactile feel.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (hover, focus, active).

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Quick feedback for hover states and button interactions.

motion.name: duration-normal
motion.purpose: Standard transition duration for most UI state changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action button. University Maroon with white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #7A1E1E; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #5a1010; transform: translateY(-0.5px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7A1E1E; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary CTA. Exam Gold with black text.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #F2B744; color: #000000; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e5a830; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F2B744; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Borderless secondary action. Transparent with maroon text and border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: #7A1E1E; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid rgba(122, 30, 30, 0.25); cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: rgba(122, 30, 30, 0.5); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7A1E1E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Standard content surface. White on off-white, no shadow.
components.html:
Card Title

Description text goes here.

Card content area with consistent padding.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E5E5E5; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; } .ds-card-header { margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #000000; line-height: 1.3; margin: 0 0 4px 0; } .ds-card-description { font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #737373; margin: 0; } .ds-card-content { font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: #000000; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Standard text input. Transparent background with border, maroon ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { background: transparent; color: #000000; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #E5E5E5; font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; width: 100%; height: 36px; box-sizing: border-box; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #737373; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #7A1E1E; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Active/inactive navigation link in the dark sidebar.
components.html: 📊Dashboard📝Exams
components.css: .ds-sidebar { background: #0d0f14; padding: 8px; width: 218px; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); text-decoration: none; transition: all 150ms; position: relative; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); } .ds-nav-active { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-nav-active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 2px; height: 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #7A1E1E; } .ds-nav-icon { width: 14px; height: 14px; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.description: Mono uppercase label with gold bubble marker. Marketing section accent.
components.html: LET Review · Cebu Normal University
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.22em; color: #7A1E1E; } .ds-eyebrow-bubble { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #F2B744; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(122, 30, 30, 0.4); }

components.name: Answer Bubble Marker
components.description: OMR-style list marker. Bordered circle with gold inner dot.
components.css: .ds-bubble-mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 16px; height: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(122, 30, 30, 0.3); margin-top: 4px; } .ds-bubble-mark::after { content: ''; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #F2B744; }

narrative.overview:
The visual system evokes the focused energy of a university review center — structured, purposeful, and quietly confident. Every surface communicates that this is a place of serious preparation, not casual browsing. The aesthetic sits between editorial warmth and institutional authority: muted tones that don't fatigue the eye during long study sessions, with the CNU maroon and gold providing identity anchors without shouting.

The design avoids the sterility of generic SaaS dashboards and the chaos of consumer apps. Instead, it channels the organized intensity of a well-run review center — clear hierarchy, consistent spacing, and just enough warmth to feel human. The OMR answer-sheet motif (bubble markers, shaded grids) is the signature visual device, connecting the digital experience to the physical exam ritual students know.
keyCharacteristics: Muted academic palette — deep maroon and warm gold on parchment-like surfaces
Structured typography — serif headlines for authority, sans-serif body for readability
Flat & tonal depth — background shifts convey hierarchy, not shadows
Answer-sheet motif — OMR bubbles and dot grids as recurring visual texture
Dark sidebar as anchor — the constant navigation frame across all roles

rules.name: The Fifteen Percent Rule
rules.body: The primary maroon appears on ≤15% of any given screen. Its rarity is what gives it weight.

rules.name: The Warmth Rule
rules.body: The marketing site uses warm whites (#F7F4EE) and warm borders (#e6ddd3), not cool grays. The app interior uses neutral whites.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Mono uppercase text appears as a prefixed label (with a gold bubble marker) above section titles — never as body text, never as a button label.

rules.name: The Flat Interior Rule
rules.body: The app interior is shadow-free. Cards, modals, and surfaces are differentiated by background color and borders, not elevation.

rules.name: The Radius Hierarchy
rules.body: Interactive elements (buttons, inputs) use 8px. Content surfaces (cards, modals) use 12px. Decorative frames use 16px.

dos: Do use the answer-sheet dot grid as ambient texture on marketing section headers
Do keep the primary maroon at ≤15% of any screen
Do use Fraunces serif for headlines that need institutional authority
Do use Lexend for everything functional — body text, labels, navigation, buttons
Do maintain the warm-white / warm-border palette on the marketing site
Do use the mono eyebrow pattern above section titles on marketing pages
Do keep the sidebar dark across all themes
donts: Don't add shadows to app-interior cards or surfaces
Don't use the primary maroon for backgrounds, large surfaces, or decorative fills
Don't mix warm whites with cool grays in the same context
Don't use serif fonts for functional UI elements (buttons, labels, nav items)
Don't exceed rounded-xl (12px) for interactive elements
Don't use the answer-sheet dot grid inside the app interior
